name: Handcrafted Ceramic Flower Vase
description:
Hand-thrown ceramic vase with a soft gloss glaze, made for dried stems and fresh flowers.

Each piece is shaped on the potter's wheel, so the throwing rings and glaze tones vary slightly — no two vases are exactly alike. It sits beautifully on a console, side table or shelf and pairs well with warm wood and neutral walls.
highlights: Hand-thrown ceramic|Glossy glaze|Watertight for fresh flowers|Each piece is unique|Gift-ready packing
care: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Hand-wash only. Avoid harsh cleaners.
